requirement.normalizedRequirement: IF ship_category IN {'A','B'} AND ice_concentration_tenths > 1 AND extended_period_operation = true AND sewage_discharge_occurs = true, THEN approved_sewage_treatment_plant_used = true, MARPOL_IV_9_1_1_or_9_2_1_certification_status = compliant, and administration_discharge_approval_status = approved.
requirement.requiredInputs: Ship category, operating ice data, treatment-plant certificate, and discharge approval
requirement.source: International Code for Ships Operating in Polar Waters (Polar Code)
requirement.sourceText: Category A and B ships that operate in areas of ice concentrations exceeding 1/10 for extended periods of time, may only discharge sewage using an approved sewage treatment plant certified by the Administration to meet the operational requirements in regulation 9.1.1 or 9.2.1 of MARPOL Annex IV. Such discharges shall be subject to approval by the Administration.
